note: A rule belongs in the prompt only if it changes what the model WRITES. If a checker catches it after the fact, stating it in the prompt buys nothing and is paid on every turn. This file makes that judgement explicit and reviewable instead of leaving it to whoever edits AGENTS.md next. `dops card --audit` fails if an invariant is missing here.

classes.generative: no checker exists — the rule survives only in the prompt. ALWAYS on the card.
classes.generative_and_verified: a checker exists, but the fix is expensive downstream (markup rewrite, token re-layering). Cheaper to state once than to iterate. ON the card, one line.
classes.verified: a checker catches it and the fix is local. NOT on the card — dops verify is the enforcement.
classes.process: orchestrator/gate mechanics, not generation. NOT on the generation card.

A.7.line: A restyle edits tokens, never components — markup is not a skin property.

A.12.line: Every async block is a 7-state automaton: idle, loading, skeleton, populated, empty, error, success. Designing only the ideal state is a defect.

A.13.line: Interactive looks interactive: every clickable carries a visual marker + hover state; every action answers within 400 ms.

A.14.line: One primary CTA per view; secondary actions are outline/ghost.

A.15.line: All sizes in rem, never px — layout must survive system font size and 200% zoom.

A.17.line: Animate transform and opacity only; interruptible by new input; a prefers-reduced-motion quiet version always.

A.18.line: Semantic HTML before ARIA; one h1; heading hierarchy continuous.

A.19.line: Never colour alone: status = colour + icon + text.

A.20.line: Mobile-first; components adapt, not pages; a breakpoint goes where the content breaks, not where a device is.

A.21.line: Tokens flow primitive -> semantic -> component, never back down the chain — and markup uses the alias the skin declares, not the token behind it.

A.25.note: gate-overtaking: a latency rule about WHEN the human answers, not about what gets written. Orchestrator-level.

A.26.note: 'nothing silently' — announcement discipline, orchestrator-level. Off the generation card by class, NOT by importance: it is the fix for the kruto incident and lives in AGENTS.md + the orchestrator SKILL.

A.27.note: external-service boundary: routing rule, not a writing rule.
